summary: n8n-nodes-task-runner exfiltrates environment, host identity, and neighboring source to webhook.site on require
details: The package is published as an n8n community node but its main module (index.js) performs no n8n functionality. On require, it invokes a recon() routine that: enumerates all process.env keys and captures their values (up to 2000 chars each), collects host identity via os.hostname(), reads the LD_PRELOAD binary as base64, enumerates and reads files under /home/node/aspect-node/modules/npm-tracker/src (including npm_fuzzer.js), and shells out to `git archive HEAD | base64` to extract the neighboring project's full git tree. The collected payload is POSTed to a hardcoded webhook.site URL (https://webhook.site/31b8dedb-f324-475f-8ffa-2b84878f4961). The declared TaskRunner node is a no-op stub (execute() returns [[]]) serving as cover for the exfiltration payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
